name: Esuna Yuuki
source:
Yuuki when he was in middle school.

When he learned that [url=https://vndb.org/c69535]Aya-nee[/url] was going to graduate, he got scared and ran to declare his love to her, but got rejected and Yuuki ended up with his heart broken.
